policy: Exactly one benchmark-owned change event is disclosed only after the candidate's baseline submission receipt is sealed. The response is evaluated separately from the baseline.
prohibitedCategories: new actuator family unavailable in the public catalogue
change that invalidates the public task boundary
candidateDisclosure: The candidate receives the complete changed requirement and affected input values at change-event start. Later candidates do not receive earlier candidate change responses.
integrity: The event payload, trigger checkpoint, response checkpoint, and prior receipt digest must be hash-bound before disclosure.
freezeRequirement: The actual payload and digest are evaluator-sealed before any official cohort begins.
